patthana22.12:1.1: na kusalaṃ na pariyāpannaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato pariyāpanno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. na akusalaṃ na pariyāpannaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato pariyāpanno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. na abyākataṃ na pariyāpannaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato pariyāpanno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā pañca.
patthana22.12:2.1: na kusalaṃ na apariyāpannaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo apariyāpanno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: …abyākato apariyāpanno dhammo ... dve. akusalamūle dve. dukamūle dve. hetuyā cha. nakusalattika naniyyānikaduke kusalattika niyyānikadukaṃ
